background: An authored song by Lenče and Goran Kukić, first performed at the Tetovo Filigrani music festival in 1996. Pesna.org points to a separate traditional song, *Се навали Шар Планина* (#516). Mood: proud, rousing, a celebration of song and dance as a force that carries a people through the centuries.
background_source: Source of these notes: the note on Pesna.org.

lines.cyr: Шара подава рака мост да направи
lines.lat: Šara podava raka most da napravi
lines.en: Shar stretches out her hand to build a bridge,
so that a day may dawn, hey, higher
than all the ages.

lines.cyr: Глас од ридови бујни оро виорат,
lines.lat: Glas od ridovi bujni oro viorat,
lines.en: Voices from lush hills whirl the kolo dance,
pearly songs, to build a bridge,
so that a day may dawn.

lines.cyr: Од тешко оро, од силна песна,
lines.lat: Od teško oro, od silna pesna,
lines.en: From a heavy dance, from a mighty song,
Shar Mountain has burst open.

lines.cyr: Како галија бела в' небо високо
lines.lat: Kako galija bela v' nebo visoko
lines.en: Like a white galley in the high sky
she has set sail, like the songs
through the centuries.

lines.cyr: А со песната наша век векувавме,
lines.lat: A so pesnata naša vek vekuvavme,
lines.en: And with our song we lived out our age,
we lived, and even the hardest
we got through.

lines.cyr: Од тешко оро, од силна песна,
lines.lat: Od teško oro, od silna pesna,
lines.en: From a heavy dance, from a mighty song,
Shar Mountain has burst open.
Let the maidens' dance whirl now, the kolo,
the brides', hey, let everything
Macedonian dance.
Come, all together, let it thunder,
the bachelors' dance, let everything
Macedonian shake.

lines.cyr: Од тешко оро, од силна песна,
lines.lat: Od teško oro, od silna pesna,
lines.en: From a heavy dance, from a mighty song,
Shar Mountain has burst open.
